t: The Magnusson Multi Detector is an essential tool for accurate material detection. It precisely locates ferrous metals, non-ferrous metals, and live wires, with detection depths up to 80mm for metals and 60mm for live wires. Featuring an intuitive LCD display, bar-graph and numeric indication, and auto calibration, this device ensures reliable results. An audible and visual alarm system enhances safety, while the auto power off function conserves battery life. This robust detector comes with a 5-year guarantee, providing peace of mind for various construction and DIY tasks.
b: Detects Ferrous Metals, Non-Ferrous Metals & Live Wires
Bar-Graph & Numeric Indication for Easy Indication
